routes.name: Universal disk reconstruction with identified quotients

C9000027.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 027 (Potential integral density on curve character varieties.; papers: Integral points on character varieties of curves; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/027.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN_DENSITY.statement: The manuscript main theorem on ambient integral density, including exact quasi-unipotent boundary classes.

C_DIAGRAM_DENSITY.statement: Integral density for every surface diagram, by induction on maximal rank.

C_NONCLOSED_DENSITY.statement: Proposition nonclosed-reduction, conditional on completed smaller-rank density.

C_BAND_RECONSTRUCTION.statement: Cut-band solutions sew through full two-flag-compatible isomorphisms.

C_DISK_RECONSTRUCTION.statement: Every admissible lower-disk solution reconstructs with all quotient identifications, affine integral parameters, and cyclic closure.

C_TWO_FLAGS.statement: Reduced row-to-column galleries have a common splitting and affine full-gallery matching maps.

C_FILTERED_LIFT.statement: The identified-quotient lift space is Hom(Q,U)/K, with K defined by h(Q_i) contained in U_(i-1).

C_SPLIT_RECONSTRUCTION.statement: The split gadget supplies the coarse exact sequence and its internal flag; each separate restriction is an affine surjection.

C_SWAP_RECONSTRUCTION.statement: The negative-scalar swap supplies the full decomposed coarse exact sequence and both separate affine restrictions.

C_DISK_CLOSURE.statement: Surjective one-sided vertex lifts close automatically at the unique prefix lift, including identified quotients.

C_GENERIC_SWAP_NORMALIZATION.statement: Arbitrary lower swap data with all allowed off-diagonal shears and invertible contact maps normalize by invertible maps block diagonal on A direct-sum B, preserving all named quotient identifications; the -I contact equation suffices.

C_FORMAL_RECONSTRUCTION_CORE.statement: For arbitrary additive commutative groups the swap has the displayed chain contraction; every finite dependent path of separately surjective events closes at a subsingleton anchor with an endpoint transport.

C_PARAMETER_DENSITY.statement: The specified free additive parameters and general linear frame changes have dense integral choices.

C_CLOSED_STEP.statement: Closed-facet density, including torus density, surface irreducibility, and twist directions; outside this mission.

C_EXACT_DESCENT.statement: Uniform-field determinant descent and exact-Jordan selection on the character quotient; outside this mission.
